_comment: Provider registry (FR-06, FR-43). implementation_status = what this build contains. approval_status: 'fr_recommended' = named in the Functional Requirements as a recommended integration; used for non-commercial evaluation only, terms still to be confirmed by the team (FR-09). 'pending_supervisor_approval' = NOT used until a supervisor approves it (set to 'approved' and record approved_by/approved_on). Licence and limit facts were read from each provider's public documentation in Oct 2026 and must be re-confirmed (FR-09).

providers.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis)
providers.usage_limits: Free tier: non-commercial use only, fair-use limits (about 10,000 calls/day). Commercial use requires an API subscription key (customer endpoint) or self-hosting.
providers.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0), based on Copernicus ERA5 reanalysis
providers.known_limitations: Gridded reanalysis at ~25 km represents regional conditions, not site microclimate. Not a direct observation.
providers.approval_note: Named in FR §3 item 2. Free tier is NON-COMMERCIAL only.

providers.name: NASA POWER Daily API (MERRA-2 / CERES)
providers.usage_limits: Free; NASA asks users to limit request rates. No API key.
providers.license: NASA open data (public domain); attribution requested
providers.attribution: Data obtained from the NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project funded through the NASA Earth Science Directorate Applied Science Program
providers.known_limitations: Coarser grid than ERA5 (~50 km). Wind is at 2 m, not comparable to Open-Meteo 10 m maximum wind, so wind is excluded when POWER is used as a fallback.
providers.approval_note: Named in FR §3 item 1 and A.4.

providers.name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
providers.geographic_coverage: Global, completeness varies strongly by place
providers.temporal_resolution: Live database snapshot at retrieval time
providers.usage_limits: Public instance: fair use (well under 10,000 queries/day, limited concurrent requests).
providers.known_limitations: Unmapped features are not proof of absence. Building heights are rarely mapped.
providers.approval_note: Named in FR §3 item 5. Public Overpass instances are for fair use; heavy/commercial workloads should use an own instance or regional extract.

providers.name: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature (via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC)
providers.spatial_resolution: 30 m product grid (thermal band acquired at 100 m and resampled by USGS)
providers.temporal_resolution: 8–16 day revisit (Landsat 8 + 9), daytime overpass ~10:00–10:30 local solar time
providers.authentication: none (anonymous SAS token from Planetary Computer)
providers.usage_limits: Planetary Computer fair-use; SAS tokens expire after ~1 hour.
providers.license: Landsat data: public domain (USGS). Planetary Computer terms of use apply to the access service.
providers.attribution: Landsat Collection 2 courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; accessed via Microsoft Planetary Computer
providers.known_limitations: Land SURFACE temperature at overpass time on clear days only; not air temperature or pedestrian thermal comfort. Thermal band native resolution is 100 m.
providers.access_note: The FR names USGS as the source. This build reads the identical USGS Collection 2 product from the Planetary Computer mirror because it needs no credentials. Confirm this access route with the supervisor.
providers.approval_note: Access route approved by the project owner for Phase 1 evaluation. The products (USGS Landsat C2 L2 / ESA Sentinel-2 L2A) are named in the FR; the Planetary Computer route is not, so supervisor confirmation is still recommended before release.
providers.approved_by: Project owner (approved in the development session)

providers.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A (via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC)
providers.authentication: none (anonymous SAS token from Planetary Computer)
providers.usage_limits: Planetary Computer fair-use; SAS tokens expire after ~1 hour.
providers.license: Copernicus Sentinel data terms (free, full and open)
providers.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data; accessed via Microsoft Planetary Computer

units.reflectance: unitless (DN/10000, minus 1000 offset for processing baseline ≥ 04.00)

providers.known_limitations: NDVI indicates vegetation-related reflectance; it does not measure canopy health, shade or cooling.
providers.access_note: The FR proposes the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (account required). This build reads the identical ESA L2A product from the Planetary Computer mirror. A CDSE adapter is not implemented.
providers.approval_note: Access route approved by the project owner for Phase 1 evaluation. The products (USGS Landsat C2 L2 / ESA Sentinel-2 L2A) are named in the FR; the Planetary Computer route is not, so supervisor confirmation is still recommended before release.
providers.approved_by: Project owner (approved in the development session)

providers.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
providers.known_limitations: Registered for planning only; requires credentials and an approved access route.

providers.name: NASA Earthdata (Login, CMR search, product downloads)
providers.known_limitations: Not used in this build. An Earthdata account alone is not a dataset.

providers.name: Open-Meteo Air Quality API
providers.known_limitations: Optional in FR; deferred to Phase 2.

providers.name: WorldPop API
providers.known_limitations: Optional in FR; deferred to Phase 2.

providers.name: Manual dataset upload (GeoTIFF)
providers.known_limitations: An upload is not verified merely because it was uploaded; CRS, coverage, units and no-data are checked.
